about: Hosted files of C8(3), in the project's Zenodo data record (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466766). Paths ("name") are relative to GFF/data/C8_3/; "remote" is the file of the record that holds it: its repository path with / replaced by __, or one of the two bundles. base_url is the record's file URL; a file is base_url/remote. Tiers: replay (optional replay steps H), test (test-native, test-full, test-replay), rerun (a production rerun), optional (prod_tails.py only). Fetched and placed by code/LRI_C8_D3_HPC/public/fetch_data.py (make -f public.mk fetch-data [TIER=...] [ZENODO=...]).
